description: Replace sqrt-based distance with squared distance for per-tick range comparisons, eliminating math.sqrt from hot paths that run every second per missile/radar unit.

changes.description: Added get3DDistSq helper — same math without sqrt, no 'or 0' guards since DCS getPoint() always returns a full vec3.
changes.after:
local function get3DDistSq(p1, p2)
    local dx = p1.x - p2.x
    local dy = p1.y - p2.y
    local dz = p1.z - p2.z
    return dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz
end

changes.description: Pre-squared the five spoof range thresholds so no sqrt is needed during comparison. Field named rangeSq (not distSq) to distinguish it from the loop variable distSq. sqrt is deferred to the rare spoof event for the nm display string only.
Use squared distance for the per-missile comparison. sqrt only computed on the rare spoof event for the display string.
changes.before:
local dist = get3DDist(pos, mp)
...
if dist < z.dist and math.random(100) <= z.pk then
    local nm = math.floor(dist/1852)
changes.after:
local distSq = get3DDistSq(pos, mp)
...
if distSq < z.rangeSq and math.random(100) <= z.pk then
    local nm = math.floor(math.sqrt(distSq)/1852)
